title: Website Editor
intro: Edit the public website in English and Spanish. Changes stay in this draft until you publish them. Every published version can be restored from History.

status.published: Website changes published. Refresh the public website to see them. The previous version is saved in History.
status.restored: Selected version restored as a new published version. Refresh the website to see it.

errors.load: We could not load website settings. Your admin session may need to be refreshed. Try again before editing.
errors.publish: Publishing failed. Your draft is still here. Check the fields and try again.
errors.restore: Restoring failed. The current website and your draft remain available. Try again.
errors.history: Version history could not be loaded. Refresh this list to try again.
errors.conflict: Another admin published a newer version. Your draft is still here. Review or copy your edits, then discard this draft and reload the latest version before publishing.

copy.help: Choose a page, then change its text in either language. Both long sections and individual form labels are available. Use the Menu and Team sections for menu labels and people profiles. Form delivery and contact requirements stay connected to the existing lead system.
copy.search: Find words or a text reference
copy.reset: Use original text in both languages
copy.no_matches: No text matches this search. Try another word or page.
copy.structured_team: Edit individual people, their roles, descriptions and photos in the Team tab. General Team page headings and section descriptions are editable here.
copy.structured_menu: Edit main menu item labels and their order in the Menu tab. Other shared labels and navigation controls are editable here.

gallery.heading: Homepage rotating gallery
gallery.help: Choose up to five active properties and put them in the order you want. Pick each cover photo from its listing, paste a public photo link, or upload one.
gallery.auto: Deals of the Week first; selected properties when no deals are active
gallery.featured: Always show my selected featured properties
gallery.deals_help: To mark a property as a deal, use Listings → Set as Deal of Week. This editor chooses the gallery order and photos; it does not change prices or discounts.
gallery.active_only: Only active properties with photos can appear. If this property is unavailable, remove it or reactivate it in Listings.
gallery.empty_default: With no custom selections, the five original approved properties will be used. Add a property to create your own selection.
gallery.search: Search active listings by title or location
gallery.search_error: Could not search listings. Refresh your admin session or try another search.

photos.heading: Website photos
photos.help: Replace a photo with a public HTTPS link or upload JPEG, PNG or WebP. Uploaded files are stored immediately; the website uses the replacement only after you publish.
photos.blank_default: Leave this blank to use the original website photo.
photos.uploading: Uploading photos… Please wait before publishing or leaving this page.
photos.upload_error: Photo upload failed. The current photo was kept. Try again.
photos.file_error: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image no larger than 10 MB.

menu.help: Move items into the order you want, rename them in both languages, or hide them. Keep at least one item; use the visibility checkbox to hide the last item. Resources keeps its existing guide and calculator links.

areas.help: Rename or rearrange broad search areas and choose their cities/provinces. Each location belongs to one area: selecting it here moves it out of any other area. Locations left unassigned appear under Other locations. Keep at least one area and one location in each area.
areas.search: Find a city or province in the choices below

resources.help: Add links with descriptions in both languages. Public resources appear in Resources; realtor tools can be restricted to signed-in realtors and admins. Official searches open the official website. Add public HTTPS links without passwords or access tokens. Removing an original official tool hides it; its row stays here so you can turn it back on.

team.help: Update names, photos, roles and descriptions, add people, or change their order. Keep at least one profile; use visibility to hide the last one.

history.heading: Published website history
history.help: Choose a saved version, then restore it. Restoring creates a new version, so the current version remains in history. This restores website content and layout settings; it does not change listings, leads or CRM data.
history.finish_draft: Publish or discard your unpublished edits before restoring a version.

validation.bilingual: Enter both English and Spanish labels (up to 160 characters each).
validation.placeholders: Keep the original text markers and formatting tags, and stay within 6,000 characters.
validation.duplicate: Use each menu destination only once.
validation.gallery: Choose up to five different gallery properties.
validation.url: Use a public HTTPS link without credentials, private addresses or access tokens.
validation.area: Choose at least one location for each area.
validation.duplicate_location: Assign a location to only one area.
validation.description: Descriptions can contain up to 4,000 characters per language.
validation.team: Enter a name (up to 120 characters) and a public HTTPS photo link.
validation.too_many: This section has too many entries. Remove an entry before publishing.
validation.size: This draft is too large. Reduce the amount of replacement text before publishing.

guard.draft: You have unpublished website edits. Leave this page and discard this draft?
guard.upload: A photo upload is still running. Leaving may leave it unfinished. Leave this page anyway?
guard.cached: Leave Website Editor? Your draft will remain in this browser tab for your admin account, ready to review when you return.

cache.saved: Draft saved in this browser tab for your admin account. It is not published or stored as a cloud backup.
cache.not_saved: The latest draft could not be saved in this browser yet. Finish any photo or website links before leaving; keep this page open to preserve incomplete edits.
cache.unavailable: Browser draft storage is unavailable. Keep this page open until you publish or copy your edits.
cache.recovered: Draft recovered from this browser. Review it before publishing.
cache.stale: This browser has an unpublished draft based on an older website version. The latest published website is loaded below; the old draft was not applied. Download it for comparison, then discard the old copy before publishing any fresh edits.
cache.invalid: A saved browser draft could not be safely restored. The current published website is loaded below. Download the saved copy for review or discard it before publishing fresh edits.
